content.thinking:
I'm reading through the delivery note from Dongguan Precision Housings, number SN-260908-115 dated 2026-09-08, tied to PO 4500318691. The line is CMP-GAM-010, a die-cast "The Getaway" statue, 15 pieces across 30 packages, with a gross weight of 600 kg and a carrier named Nord.

I'm checking the remaining fields of the delivery note: the carrier, the empty remarks and signature lines, and the two stamps. The quantity "15.000" is the open question, since the dot could be a decimal point (15 pieces) or a thousands separator (15,000 pieces), and 15 pieces across 30 packages doesn't add up.

I'm weighing whether the "15.000" quantity reads as 15 pieces under the Chinese decimal convention, since 30 packages for 15 pieces seems off. I'll flag that conflict, and I'm also settling the date format, where the 12.10.2026 stamp reads as 12 October 2026.

I'm checking the stamp on the delivery note and the position of the red seal, which partly covers the PCS unit and the "30" in the package column, though both remain readable. The description line looks cut off after "die-cast, 18", and the receiver signature and remarks are blank. I'm noting the transit dates from 8 September to 12 October 2026 without reading anything into them.

I'm deciding whether the stamps and remarks count as notes to report; the receiving stamp is a stamp note rather than a correction, so I'll list it. I'm also settling which references go in the output: the PO number 4500318691 and the delivery note SN-260908-115, with the carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S noted as a shipment detail.

I'm settling the remaining fields: the issuer is the supplier and the recipient is the Hamburg distribution center, with the document in Chinese and English. The status leans toward a warning flag because of the quantity ambiguity and the blank signature, so I'm keeping the confidence at medium and leaving the date field empty.

verdict.summary_en: Supplier delivery note SN-260908-115 dated 2026-09-08 from Dongguan Precision Housings to Soony DC Hamburg, for PO 4500318691. It has one line, CMP-GAM-010 Statue "The Getaway", with quantity 15.000 PCS in 30 packages and a gross weight of 600 kg. Carrier is Nordhav Shipping A/S. It carries a blue DC-HAM receiving stamp dated 12.10.2026 and the red supplier seal. There are no handwritten corrections. The remarks field and the receiver signature line are blank.
red_flags: Quantity "15.000" is ambiguous. Read with the Chinese decimal-point convention it is 15 PCS. Read as a thousands separator it is 15,000 PCS. Receiver signature line (收货签字) is blank. Only the DC-HAM receiving stamp is present.
The description is cut off at "(die-cast, 18", so the full product specification is not visible.
The receiving stamp does not record any received quantity or inspection result.

The description text is truncated at the column edge.
The blue stamp reads RECEIVED 12.10.2026 with DC-HAM below it. It is clear, and the date is in DD.MM.YYYY format.
The remarks field (备注) is empty.
The barcode at the top right was not decoded.
No handwriting is visible anywhere on the page.
